title: Confession and Autopsy
author: Emrys Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Oyelaran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
